about_the_game:
Barber Shop Simulator – A Hands-On First-Person Hair Cutting Experience

Step into the buzzing world of high-stakes grooming in Barber Shop Simulator, a first-person simulation game where every cut counts and style is everything. From simple trims to full-on makeovers, you’ll take control of your own barber shop and rise through the ranks by mastering the art of hair.

Grab your scissors, fire up the clippers, and get ready to shape the perfect look—just don’t slip, because your reputation is on the line.

Cut, Style, and Shave

Welcome your clients, listen to their requests, and transform their appearance with precision tools and skilled hands. Use scissors, razors, clippers, and combs to achieve the look they’re after—or surprise them with your own creative touch. From trendy fades to classic beard styles, no two jobs are the same, and perfection takes practice.

The better you do, the more customers will line up for your chair.

Reputation is Everything

Every client that walks through your door has expectations. Deliver high-quality haircuts and flawless shaves to earn tips, positive reviews, and a growing clientele. But mess up a trim or take too long, and word will spread fast. Balance speed, precision, and creativity to build your reputation and become the most trusted name in the neighborhood.

Upgrade Your Shop and Tools

Start with basic gear and a humble shop, then reinvest your profits into better tools, stylish interiors, and advanced equipment. Improve your workstation with high-end clippers, specialty razors, and professional-grade chairs to make your work easier—and your results sharper. Impress your clients not just with your cuts, but with your environment.

Master Advanced Techniques

As you level up, you’ll unlock more complex hairstyles, beards, and grooming requests. Learn to blend seamlessly, apply shaving cream like a pro, and even carve artistic designs into hair. Practice makes perfect, and mastering advanced techniques will set you apart from your competition.

Build Your Barber Empire

Expand your shop, hire assistants, and take on more clients as your fame spreads. Compete in local barber challenges, win grooming awards, and climb the ranks of the barbering world. From a street corner buzz-cutter to a city-renowned stylist, your journey is yours to shape—literally.

Are you ready to pick up the clippers and change lives one haircut at a time?
Barber Shop Simulator puts you in the chair behind the chair. Precision, style, and hustle—this is more than just a haircut, it's an experience.

name: Barber Shop Simulator
short_description: Barber Shop Simulator is a first-person simulation game where you run your own barbershop from scratch. Serve a wide variety of customers, each with unique styles and preferences. Offer everything from quick fades to full beard grooming. Upgrade your shop, and become the most chosen barber in town.
